rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest calls, both clear: chunk1 L5 'The same question, two answers.' opens with a forward-referencing definite NP resolved two clauses later in the SAME sentence group ('Then the second prompt: "What should we have for dinner?"') — same-chunk resolution, not a pointer at a later SLIDE, which is what the rule's own banned example targets. chunk2 header (L11) 'the answer' and L15 'the question' read as the lecture's deliberate generic device (any answer/any question), reinforced by chunk1's established two-answers frame — a term introduced on an earlier slide of the same file and reused, the compendium's explicit NOT-violation shape. No other pronoun/demonstrative in either chunk (L5-9, L13-15 'it', 'All of it') lacks an in-sentence antecedent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk1 "Context is King": L7 guess line 'Take a guess before it runs. What does Claude suggest now?' precedes L9 reveal 'Something Finnish: salmon, rye bread, meatballs.' — reveal follows guess in reading order, same chunk, matching maintainer standing-constraint L25 ('Guess before reveal. The guess paragraph precedes the Finnish-dinner answer.').

3 chunks, none orphaned: chunk0 (L1) is a plain title slide, not a wait-state or context-dependent bullet; chunk1 (L3-9) and chunk2 (L11-15) each carry multiple self-carrying sentences (the two-session narration; 'Context is whatever you tell it … The move is loading the right context before the question').

chunk1 header 'Context is King' (L3) is borne out by the body's demonstration that prior context conditions the answer (L5-9); chunk2 header 'You steer the answer by loading context' (L11) is borne out by L13-15 ('Context is whatever you tell it … The move is loading the right context'). Neither header is contradicted by its chunk's content.

All six sub-items checked against both chunks: `grep -nE 'Not [A-Z][a-z]+\.'` on L1-16 → no match (exit 1); no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative (body never claims its own usefulness — that claim lives only in the maintainer block, out of scope); no number-plus-retraction (view greps `dated_line`/`url`/`banned_words` all body_hits:0, and a direct read finds zero numerals in the body); no abstraction-noun stack (concrete nouns throughout — prompt, session, dinner, context, answer); no empty-leg verb triplet.
